_comment: Per-character speaking style. Same system, different numbers, so one line reads as a different person. Tune by eye.

_fields.wpm: words per minute, sets syllable duration
_fields.jaw_max: degrees; the character's widest opening. Range for Live is -3.25 (closed) to +30
_fields.jaw_closed: degrees at rest; the mesh is modelled mouth-open so this is negative
_fields.pause_hold: seconds held closed at a full stop
_fields.comma_hold: seconds held closed at a comma
_fields.undershoot: 0..1, how far short of the target each syllable stops; mumbling
